intent: light roast - fix insufficient drying and moisture loss across previous roasts
variable_changed: charge at 215C after 8 min preheat and hold through drying (color-triggered, not clock-triggered); planned steps 215->225 at full yellow and 225->230 at cinnamon; no planned temp reduction at FC onset
hypothesis: Holding 215C through the full drying phase until visual full yellow will drive adequate moisture loss (target 12-14% weight loss). Color-triggered steps rather than clock-triggered steps will allow the drying phase to complete before pushing into Maillard. This should produce better sweetness and body compared to the flat, baked profiles seen across the previous three roasts.

adjustments.reason: first planned step; color was already essentially cinnamon, so the step landed later than the planned full-yellow trigger
first crack end; plan called for 225->230 at cinnamon, took 225->235 here instead

sensory.aroma_drying: toasted bread at 2:30, beans still green
sensory.aroma_maillard: caramel/toffee at 5:00 as yellowing began; roasted peanut at 7:00
sensory.color_at_yellowing: starting to yellow at 5:00; full peanut color at 7:00
sensory.crack_character: first crack onset 13:30, end 16:00 - 2:30 of crack
sensory.observations: Timer counted down from 18:00; elapsed times derived as 18:00 minus remaining. Preheated to 215C for 8 min before charge, first batch of the day, ambient 75F. Silverskin visibly loosening at 8:00 and shedding heavily at 15:00; nearly all gone at drop. Dropped to cooldown at 17:30, 7 min cooling cycle, then into a colander. Plan carried forward from roast-20260502-002 (created 2026-05-02, never roasted); that placeholder file was removed when this roast was logged. Deviations from plan: the 215->225 step was taken at 10:00 when color was already cinnamon rather than at full yellow (~7:00), and the second step went to 235C at first crack end rather than 230C at cinnamon.

cuppings.brew_method: cupping - 8.25g coarse ground, 150mL at 93C, 4 min steep, crust broken at 4:00
cuppings.aroma_dry: dark chocolate, dried fruit (possibly stone fruit)
cuppings.aroma_wet: chocolate-forward, less dried fruit than the dry aroma; notably substantial and dense, not thin

acidity.notes: bright, clean citrus; a slight touch of sourness at the front

sweetness.notes: honey; major lift over the flat 2/5 of the May cup

body.notes: medium; up from thin (2/5) in May

cuppings.finish_quality: sweet with lingering acidity on the back of the tongue; pleasant
cuppings.tasting_notes_free: Big step up from the May cup (6/10, flagged baked). Bake characteristics fully resolved: sweetness doubled, body up, and the finish went from absent to long and sweet. Cup reads complex and layered - individual notes hard to isolate, which is characteristic of a natural Ethiopian rather than a fault. Chocolate and stone fruit appeared on the nose but did not carry into the cup. One flaw remains: a black-tea-like astringency on the middle of the tongue, holding it back from higher marks.
cuppings.hypothesis_result: CONFIRMED. Holding 215C through the full drying phase with color-triggered steps drove weight loss to 12.7% (target 12-14%) and eliminated the baked profile that affected the previous three roasts. Sweetness rose from 2 to 4, body from 2 to 3, overall from 6 to 8, and the finish went from absent to long and sweet. The predicted improvement in sweetness and body was realised. New constraint surfaced at the back of the roast: development time of 90s gave DTR 0.086, roughly half the 0.15-0.25 target, producing the residual astringency.
cuppings.next_adjustment: Extend development from 90s to 150s while SHORTENING total roast time, by executing the temperature steps on their intended color triggers rather than late. This roast's steps landed ~3 min late (215->225 taken at 10:00 when color was already cinnamon, instead of at full yellow ~7:00; 225->235 taken at 16:00 / FC end instead of at cinnamon), leaving the machine at 225C through all of Maillard and all of first crack. Next roast: charge at 215C after 8 min preheat, hold through drying; step 215->225 AT full yellow (~7:00); step 225->235 AT cinnamon (~10:00); no reduction at FC onset; drop at FC end + 150s. Projected: FC onset ~11:00, FC end ~13:30, drop ~16:00, total 960s, development 150s, DTR ~0.156 (in target range). WATCH: (1) roast level will climb - expect 14-15% weight loss, likely landing medium-light to medium rather than light; if staying light is the priority, extend development to 120s instead of 150s. (2) Arriving at FC with more energy may produce a louder, faster crack and a compressed drop window - be at the machine ready to drop, and account for the CB-101's 60-90s adjustment lag.
